phase: Phase 1 core audio and scoring feasibility
decision: ACCEPTED by coordinator under owner-authorized sequential phase gates

gateMapping.requirement: Audio fades and returns on the mapped timeline without pause, seek, or drift.
gateMapping.evidence: Sample-domain envelope; all 1,632,000 rendered frames, zero digital silent energy, unchanged return PCM; physical clock residual maximum 0.003917 ms.

gateMapping.requirement: Identical simulated inputs receive stable results.
gateMapping.evidence: 22 recorded fixtures; repeated exact successful-score equality and deterministic full/partial/invalid assessment tests.

gateMapping.requirement: Deliberate acceleration, deceleration, jitter, and phase shifts produce the expected diagnosis.
gateMapping.evidence: Both modes yield expected fixture diagnoses, drift/reentry signs, jitter and 90 ms phase shift; invalid inputs retain explicit rejection.

gateMapping.requirement: Tap and Strum timestamps are repeatable enough for musician-credible scoring.
gateMapping.evidence: Three Tap baseline residual RMS 11.36–13.60 ms; three Strum 12.54/13.18/11.80 ms. Latest 65 Strum downstrokes have 64 intervals 461.86–559.96 ms, no irregular flags or runtime invalidation; crossing median/p95/max 8.320/8.323/16.640 ms. Physical partial assessments independently verified.

gateMapping.requirement: A physical-device run confirms the complete audible-to-silent-to-audible loop.
gateMapping.evidence: Owner explicitly confirmed silence then natural return, alongside physical digital timeline evidence.

limitations: Tested iPhone 16 built-in speaker only; other routes and absolute contact/acoustic precision unvalidated.

Two earlier long Strum intervals remain unexplained; neither owner omission nor absence of intermittent loss is claimed. Retain as Phase 2 reliability observation and repair engine before product acceptance if missed capture becomes reproducible.
Partial results are legitimate when landing is ambiguous; no player full-score or fixed trial quota requirement.
Phase 1 feasibility acceptance is not release readiness; Phase 2 dispatch belongs to coordinator after integration.
review: Completed authorized Sol/high focused and Terra/high cumulative reviews clean; final changes are documentation/evidence only. No new reviewer or source changes.
localValidation: 21 package tests, 16 affected iOS simulator tests and signed corrected build passed; 11 earlier physical audio/core/lifecycle tests retained for unchanged code. Documentation JSON/link/diff and source-preservation checks repeated for final checkpoint.
integration: Checkpoint ready for authorized merge after final head verification; actual merge SHA to be reported from GitHub.
